support.faq1_q: How do I create a new invoice?
support.faq1_a: You can create a new invoice by going to the Invoices page and clicking "New Invoice", then entering the client details and items and clicking save.
support.faq2_q: Can I edit an invoice after sending it?
support.faq2_a: Yes, you can edit the invoice as long as it has not been paid. Once paid, it becomes non-editable.
support.faq3_q: How do I set up an installment plan for a client?
support.faq3_a: When creating the invoice, select "Enable Installment Plan" in the payment settings step, then specify the number of installments and due dates.
